What are super 7s? Can you recommend it?

Super 7s are an exercise routine done with a barbell and your desired weight of plates (start off with 20kg total and work up in 5kg divisions). It consists of the following:

7 x Bicep curls

7 x Standing Chest press

7 x Squats

7 x Back of shoulder press

7 x Upright Rows (hips to chin)

7 x Deadlift

7 x Calf Raises

The important thing is you do all 7 of these exercises without a rest. Then you rest for about a minute and go again, until you have done 7 sets. Instead of doing 7 reps you can extend it to 10 for muscle size or just do the individual bits at 5x5 for strength. If you do the whole routine properly, you will really feel it. The squats especially.

I am far from a professional, but I find this a really good little exercise: It tones and strengthens, and works pretty much every muscle while also providing you with quite a good cardio workout.

If you are getting 'comfortable' then up the weight or I like to mix in some cross over sits-ups between sets just to really punish myself :)

If you miss or fail any set, give yourself 30 seconds of the Plank, for each failure, as punishment. That's the wonderful motivator!
